headline: Cape Holds Hot as Mooring Surge Continues
war_summary: Since the morning edition the fiercest work has narrowed to two districts. Callum's Cape remains the liveliest sector with seven changes in two hours and thirty-six on the day around Scouts Jest, Naofa and Ire, holding four Warden and three Colonial posts amid 1,208 Colonial and 1,596 Warden casualties in two hours, a slower transfer pace than before but heavier loss. Mooring County now matches it with six changes in two hours and eighteen on the day at the Wind Hills, Gravekeeper's Holdfast and the Cut, holding ten Warden, one Colonial and one ruined post amid 1,367 Colonial and 1,481 Warden casualties in two hours. Elsewhere the wireless has gone quiet in the last two hours. Godcrofts, Linn Mercy and the Weathered Expanse, busy earlier at Isawa, Outwich Ranch and Spirit Watch, record none in two hours, though Linn counts twenty-three on the day for ten Colonial posts and one ruin and the Expanse twenty-three for seven Warden posts and two ruins. The Nevish Line, Marban Hollow and Callahan's Passage also show none in two hours, Nevish still counting thirty-nine on the day for eight Colonial posts.
